description: Find the closest high-voltage substations to a Texas address or coordinate, or list those inside a county, with high and low side voltage, OpenStreetMap station class (transmission or distribution bus), owner and distance in miles. Use when someone asks where power is near a site, how far a property is from a substation, or whether a nearby station has a distribution bus to meter a load from. Pro adds mapped transformers and substations mapped in OpenStreetMap but missing from the federal layer.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

bus_kv_max.description: Pro. Keep stations that have a bus at or below this kV (the lowest mapped OpenStreetMap voltage, else the listed kV). A 345/138/69 kV station passes bus_kv_max 69, which min_kv cannot express.

county.description: Texas county name, e.g. 'Jackson'. With no address or lat/lng, lists substations inside that county, nearest the county center first.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

min_kv.description: Minimum substation voltage in kV. Default 69. Use 138 or 345 for large loads.

osm_class.description: Keep stations whose OpenStreetMap class matches. Distribution means a distribution bus is mapped.

osm_only_radius_mi.description: Pro. How far to look for substations missing from the federal layer (osm_only_substations). Default 5, max 50. Use 25 when the user asks for stations the federal data misses.

name: nearest_substation
title: Nearest substations
